tunnel.status.create.conflict_unmatched: Radient says a tunnel for this request already exists, but this login's tunnel list has no single matching record. Check lop tunnel list, then connect it with lop tunnel connect --tunnel-id <id>.
tunnel.status.gateway.listening_http_sta: Something is listening on the relay gateway port 127.0.0.1:{port}, but it answered the health check with HTTP {status}: another program may hold the port, or the gateway is unhealthy. Reinstalling will not help.
tunnel.status.gateway.listening_timed_ou: The local relay gateway is listening on 127.0.0.1:{port}, but its health answer timed out; reinstalling will not help.
tunnel.status.gateway.listening_unreadab: The local relay gateway is listening on 127.0.0.1:{port}, but its health answer was unreadable; reinstalling will not help.
tunnel.status.login.unchecked: Login: could not be checked (a refresh could not reach Radient).
tunnel.status.requests.heading: Requests (last {window}): {tally}
tunnel.status.server_unavailable.label: Radient server error
tunnel.status.server_unavailable.relay: Radient answered this computer's relay authorization check with a temporary server error. Nothing is wrong with the login or this computer; it reauthorizes by itself once Radient recovers.
tunnel.status.server_unavailable.termina: Radient answered the connector's authorization check with a temporary server error (HTTP 5xx), so the login and this computer are not at fault. It retries every 10 seconds and reauthorizes by itself once Radient recovers; no local command is needed.
